prompt.text:
You are working in a copy of the shop-sample repository (TypeScript), at the commit just before the change. Solve the problem described below by editing files in this folder.

Rules for this run:
- You cannot run commands, so you cannot run the unit tests. Do not try. Reason from the code.
- Work only inside this folder. Do not use the web. Do not use git.
- When you are done, reply with a short list of the files you changed and why.

How to work:
Solve this the way you normally would for a pull request to this repository. Use your own judgement about what belongs in the change.

## Requirements (from the pull request description)

Requirement: REQ-17 in the shop sample (requirements/REQ-17.md).

Why: REQ-17 says discounts round to the nearest cent, with half-cents rounded up. The shared pricing function rounded the discount down.

Before and after: Before: a 105-cent order at 10% gets a 10-cent discount. Total 95 cents. After: a 105-cent order at 10% gets an 11-cent discount. Total 94 cents.

Must preserve: At zero discount the total stays 105 cents.

## The requirement the Requirement row points to (requirements/REQ-17.md, word for word)

# REQ-17 Round discounts to the nearest cent

Checkout and Order Import round discounts to the nearest cent, with
half-cents rounded up.

- With a 105-cent order and a 10% discount, the discount is 11 cents and the
  total is 94 cents.
- Behaviour to preserve: at zero discount the total stays 105 cents.

Affected workflows: Checkout, Order Import.

how: Runs on the shop sample (pull request req-17), 2026-11-14. Each of 5 agents ran once with `claude -p --model claude-sonnet-5-5`, alone, in its own copy of the shop sample at the commit before req-17. Every agent got the same normal prompt (swarm-prompt.txt). No shell, no git, no web. All 5 ran at the same time.
notBuilt: The agents had no shell. Nobody ran the unit tests on their changes. We do not know if any agent's change passes them.

runs.reply:
I changed the shared discount rounding so a 105-cent order at 10% now gets an 11-cent discount (total 94). I couldn't run anything, so none of the tests have been run.

- `src/pricing/discount.ts`: the discount was `Math.floor(x/100)`. It is now `Math.floor((x + 50)/100)`, which rounds to the nearest cent with half-cents up. This is integer maths, so there is no float error. Checkout and Order Import both use this function, so both get the fix. At 0% the total stays 105.
- `docs/pricing.md`: added a line stating the rounding rule (REQ-17).
- `tests/checkout.test.ts`: added a 105 at 10% → 94 case and a 105 at 0% → 105 case.
- `tests/orderImport.test.ts`: added the same two cases using CSV rows.
